data.name: FruitGuard AI — MSc Dissertation
data.description: Researched and implemented a two-phase transfer learning pipeline (YOLOv8n) that achieved commercial-grade fruit detection accuracy using only 207 training images — a 95% reduction in data. Deployed as a real-time web app via ONNX Runtime achieving 73 FPS inference.

data.name: NeuroArc
data.description: Built an AI-powered tool that processes CVs and job descriptions and generates tailored outputs using LLMs. Improved robustness by adding schema-level input validation, structured error responses, and request logging.

data.name: Planck AI
data.description: Built a full-stack agentic AI application that orchestrates 5 tool integrations (web search, code execution, document retrieval, LLM reasoning, result synthesis). Parallelised independent tool calls using asyncio, reducing wall-clock latency for multi-step queries.

data.name: Full-Stack E-Commerce Platform
data.description: Implemented a production-grade e-commerce application with ACID transactions and row-level locking for concurrent inventory updates. Containerised with Docker Compose and set up GitHub Actions CI/CD.

data.name: CogniGraph
data.description: Built a RAG-based document explorer that extracts entities and relationships from unstructured PDFs to construct interactive knowledge graphs. Integrated ChromaDB for vector storage and semantic retrieval.
